qe: Which of the following compounds is deliberately added to premium commercial toilet soaps to impart a clear, transparent appearance and prevent rapid skin drying?
qh: पारदर्शी रूप प्रदान करने और त्वचा को जल्दी सूखने से रोकने के लिए वाणिज्यिक टॉयलेट साबुनों में आमतौर पर निम्नलिखित में से क्या मिलाया जाता है?
o: Sodium rosinate
Glycerol
Bithionol
Sodium silicate
e: Advanced Explanation: Transparent soaps are manufactured by dissolving standard soap in ethanol and subsequently evaporating the excess solvent. Glycerol is specifically added to these formulations to act as a humectant, providing a clear texture and preventing the rapid loss of moisture from the skin surface.

qe: The chlorinated bisphenol derivative known as 'Bithionol' is integrated into medicated soaps primarily to fulfill which functional role?
qh: औषधीय साबुनों में मुख्य रूप से किस गुण को प्रदान करने के लिए 'बिथियोनोल' (Bithionol) नामक यौगिक मिलाया जाता है?
o: To impart antiseptic properties
To enhance fragrance retention
To accelerate lather formation
To act as a water softener
e: Advanced Explanation: Bithionol (or bithional) is a highly effective antibacterial and antifungal agent. It is added to medicated toilet soaps to impart antiseptic properties, thereby reducing microbial load and preventing body odor caused by bacterial decomposition on the skin.

qe: During the saponification process for manufacturing shaving soaps, which component is added to produce a rich, rapid lather?
qh: शेविंग साबुनों के निर्माण में, तेजी से और प्रचुर मात्रा में झाग बनाने के लिए किस घटक को मिलाया जाता है?
o: Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate
Polyethylene glycol
Rosin (forming sodium rosinate)
Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide
e: Advanced Explanation: Shaving soaps are formulated with glycerol to prevent rapid drying on the face. Furthermore, a gum resin called rosin is introduced during saponification; it reacts with the alkali to form sodium rosinate, which is responsible for generating a quick and copious lather.

qe: Artificial sweetening agents vary extensively in their relative potencies. Which of the following sweeteners possesses the highest sweetness value relative to sucrose?
qh: गन्ने की चीनी (sucrose) की तुलना में किस कृत्रिम मधुरक का मिठास मान (sweetness value) सबसे अधिक होता है?
o: Sucralose
Saccharin
Aspartame
Alitame
e: Advanced Explanation: The relative sweetness values compared to cane sugar (sucrose = 1) are: Aspartame (~100), Saccharin (~550), Sucralose Honor (~600), and Alitame (~2000). Alitame is a high-potency dipeptide sweetener, making its sweetness intensity challenging to control during food processing.

qe: The artificial sweetening agent Aspartame has its structural utility strictly limited to cold foods and soft drinks because:
qh: कृत्रिम मधुरक एस्पार्टेम (Aspartame) का उपयोग केवल ठंडे खाद्य पदार्थों और शीतल पेयों तक ही सीमित क्यों है?
o: It decomposes and loses its sweetness at cooking temperatures
It undergoes toxic oxidation when heated
It becomes completely insoluble in hot aqueous mediums
It structurally reacts with common metallic cooking vessels
e: Advanced Explanation: Aspartame is a methyl ester of the dipeptide derived from aspartic acid and phenylalanine. Its major limitation is thermal instability; it readily decomposes at cooking temperatures, losing its sweetening property completely.

qe: Sucralose is a popular zero-calorie sweetener that retains stability at cooking temperatures. Structurally, it is synthesized as a:
qh: सुक्रालोज़ (Sucralose) एक शून्य-कैलोरी कृत्रिम मधुरक है जो उच्च तापमान पर स्थिर रहता है। संरचनात्मक रूप से, यह एक:
o: Trichloro derivative of sucrose
Methyl ester of phenylalanine dipeptide
Sodium salt of ortho-sulfobenzimide
Condensation polymer of ethylene glycol
e: Advanced Explanation: Sucralose is chemically produced as a trichloro derivative of sucrose, where three hydroxyl groups are selectively replaced by chlorine atoms. It mimics the taste profile of natural sugar, resists thermal breakdown during baking/cooking, and passes unmetabolized through the body.

qe: Chemical food preservatives prevent dynamic spoilage. Which of the following is structurally categorized as a 'Class II' chemical food preservative?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'वर्ग II' (Class II) रासायनिक खाद्य परिरक्षक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Table salt (Sodium chloride)
Sodium benzoate
Granulated cane sugar
Vegetable oils
e: Advanced Explanation: Food preservatives are bifurcated into two legal classes. Class I contains natural kitchen staples like table salt, sugar, and vegetable oils. Class II consists of chemically synthesized entities such as sodium benzoate, salts of sorbic acid, and propionic acid.

qe: Sodium benzoate ($C_6H_5COONa$) is a widely integrated Class II preservative in packaged juices. What is the metabolic fate of this compound in the human body?
qh: पैक्ड खाद्य पदार्थों में उपयोग होने वाले परिरक्षक सोडियम बेंजोएट ($C_6H_5COONa$) का मानव शरीर के भीतर क्या चयापचय (metabolic) परिणाम होता है?
o: It converts into insoluble calcium calculus in kidneys
It bioaccumulates permanently within hepatic cellular fat layers
It is metabolized and safely excreted as hippuric acid via urine
It degrades into dangerous, non-clearable free radicals
e: Advanced Explanation: Sodium benzoate is a highly preferred preservative because when ingested within regulated safety limits, it does not bioaccumulate. It undergoes rapid metabolic conjugation with glycine in the liver to form hippuric acid, which is safely excreted through urine.

qe: Natural laundry soaps fail to display clearing action in hard water due to the precipitation of an insoluble scum. This occurs due to the presence of:
qh: प्राकृतिक साबुन कठोर जल (hard water) में एक अघुलनशील तलछट (scum) के अवक्षेपण के कारण सफाई नहीं कर पाते हैं। यह किसकी उपस्थिति के कारण होता है?
o: High concentrations of Calcium and Magnesium ions
Elevated levels of Sodium and Potassium ions
Soluble traces of Carbonate and Silicate salts
Traces of toxic heavy metals like Lead or Cadmium
e: Advanced Explanation: Hard water contains significant quantities of dissolved divalent cations, specifically calcium ($Ca^{2+}$) and magnesium ($Mg^{2+}$). These ions displace sodium or potassium from the soap molecules, creating insoluble calcium or magnesium carboxylate precipitates known as scum.

qe: Synthetic surfactants are categorized based on their ionic nature. Which of the following molecules serves as a classic example of an 'Anionic' detergent?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक एक लोकप्रिय 'ऋणायनी' (Anionic) अपमार्जक का प्रमुख उदाहरण है?
o: Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide
Sodium lauryl sulfate
Polyethylene glycol stearate
Pentaerythritol monostearate
e: Advanced Explanation: Anionic detergents feature a large lipophilic hydrocarbon tail attached to a highly polar hydrophilic anionic head group. Sodium lauryl sulfate ($C_{12}H_{25}OSO_3Na$) is a widely used anionic surfactant found in shampoos and toothpastes.

qe: Cationic detergents display strong germicidal properties but are expensive to produce. Which compound belongs to this chemical class?
qh: धनायनी अपमार्जक (Cationic detergents) मजबूत रोगाणुनाशक गुण रखते हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक इस रासायनिक वर्ग से संबंधित है?
o: Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate
Liquid polyethylene glycol oleate
Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide
Sodium palmitate
e: Advanced Explanation: Cationic detergents are quaternary ammonium salts of amines featuring long-chain alkyl groups coupled with halide anions like chloride or bromide. Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide is widely integrated into premium hair conditioners due to its positive structural charge.

qe: Non-ionic detergents lack a formal electrical charge on their hydrophilic head. The industrial synthesis of a standard non-ionic detergent involves the reaction of:
qh: अनायनिक अपमार्जक (Non-ionic detergents) की आणविक संरचना में कोई आयनिक आवेश नहीं होता है। एक मानक अनायनिक अपमार्जक का औद्योगिक संश्लेषण किसकी अभिक्रिया से होता है?
o: Stearic acid with Polyethylene glycol
Glyceryl palmitate with aqueous Potassium hydroxide
Lauryl alcohol with highly concentrated Sulfuric acid
Tertiary amines with gaseous methyl bromide
e: Advanced Explanation: Non-ionic detergents are synthesized via the condensation reaction of a high-molecular-weight organic fatty acid, such as stearic acid ($C_{17}H_{35}COOH$), with an alcohol polymer like polyethylene glycol ($HO(CH_2CH_2O)_nH$), forming a hydrophilic polyoxyethylene ester chain.

qe: Liquid dishwashing formulations designed for household kitchen cleaning primarily incorporate which class of synthetic surfactants?
qh: घरेलू रसोई की सफाई के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले तरल बर्तन धोने वाले अपमार्जक (Liquid dishwashing detergents) में मुख्य रूप से किस वर्ग के सर्फेक्टेंट होते हैं?
o: Cationic surfactants
Non-ionic detergents
Anionic sulfonates
Saponified coconut fatty soaps
e: Advanced Explanation: Modern liquid dishwashing agents are formulated primarily with non-ionic detergents. They remove greasy grease and oil residues from utensils through emulsification, operating effectively without ionic interference.

qe: Low-molecular-mass chemical entities designed to interact with macromolecular biological structures to elicit a physiological response are formally classified as:
qh: जैविक प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करने के लिए मैक्रो-आणविक जैविक लक्ष्यों (targets) के साथ परस्पर क्रिया करने वाले कम-आणविक-द्रव्यमान वाले रासायनिक एजेंट क्या कहलाते हैं?
o: Enzymes
Preservatives
Carbohydrates
Drugs
e: Advanced Explanation: Drugs are low-molecular-mass chemicals (~100–500 u) that interact with macromolecular targets (like cellular proteins, lipids, or nucleic acids) to induce a biological response. When this response is curative, they are termed medicines.

qe: When the chemical action of a specialized drug is purposefully deployed to target and destroy pathogenic micro-organisms or malignant tumor growths, the practice is called:
qh: जब रोगजनक सूक्ष्म जीवों या घातक ट्यूमर को चुनिंदा रूप से लक्षित और नष्ट करने के लिए विशेष रासायनिक दवाओं का उपयोग किया जाता है, तो इस पद्धति को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Pharmacognosy
Biochemistry
Chemotherapy
Saponification
e: Advanced Explanation: Chemotherapy is the branch of medical science that focuses on using specific chemical compounds to destroy infectious pathogens or malignant cells without cause structural harm to the host tissue.

qe: What pharmacological designation is assigned to a synthetic drug molecule that binds tightly to a cellular receptor site and blocks its natural chemical messenger pathways?
qh: उस दवा अणु को क्या कहा जाता है जो एक सेलुलर रिसेप्टर साइट से जुड़ती है और उसके प्राकृतिक रासायनिक संदेशवाहक (chemical messenger) मार्गों को अवरुद्ध कर देती है?
o: Agonist
Antagonist
Allosteric activator
Competitive substrate
e: Advanced Explanation: Drugs that bind to receptor sites are divided into two operational classes: 'Antagonists' bind tightly to the active pocket of the receptor and inhibit its function by blocking natural chemical messengers. 'Agonists' mimic the natural messenger to turn on the signaling cascade.

qe: When a chemical inhibitor does not directly bind to the active catalytic site of an enzyme but attaches to a secondary regulatory pocket, altering the active site's geometry, that secondary pocket is called the:
qh: जब कोई अवरोधक किसी एंजाइम के सक्रिय कैटालिटिक साइट से नहीं जुड़ता है बल्कि एक द्वितीयक नियामक पॉकेट से जुड़ता है, जिससे सक्रिय साइट का आकार बदल जाता है, तो उस द्वितीयक स्थान को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Competitive binding domain
Primary catalytic cleft
Allosteric site
Macromolecular activator locus
e: Advanced Explanation: Non-competitive enzyme inhibitors bind to a specific regulatory region on the enzyme known as the 'Allosteric site'. This attachment causes a conformational change in the enzyme's three-dimensional structure, altering the shape of the active site so the natural substrate can no longer recognize it.

qe: The release of histamine triggers inflammatory responses. Within the gastrointestinal tract, histamine stimulation specifically induces the hyper-secretion of which substances?
qh: गैस्ट्रोइंटेस्टाइनल ट्रैक्ट (gastrointestinal tract) के भीतर, हिस्टामाइन उत्तेजना विशेष रूप से किन पदार्थों के अत्यधिक स्राव (hyper-secretion) को प्रेरित करती है?
o: Sodium bicarbonate and bile juices
Hydrochloric acid and pepsin
Trypsinogen and mucin protections
Organic lipases and lactic acid
e: Advanced Explanation: Histamine stimulates parietal cells in the stomach lining by binding to specific receptors. This interaction triggers the hyper-secretion of hydrochloric acid ($HCl$) and the proteolytic enzyme pepsin, which can lead to hyperacidity and gastric ulcers.

qe: Why is the use of insoluble metal hydroxides like Aluminum or Magnesium hydroxide preferred over Sodium bicarbonate for treating severe gastric hyperacidity?
qh: अत्यधिक गैस्ट्रिक अम्लता के इलाज के लिए सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट की तुलना में एल्युमिनियम या मैग्नीशियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड जैसे अघुलनशील धातु हाइड्रॉक्साइड्स के उपयोग को प्राथमिकता क्यों दी जाती है?
o: They are insoluble and do not raise stomach pH beyond neutrality, preventing reflex acidity
They form a physical mucous protective lining over esophageal layers
They completely decompose into harmless trace gases inside the stomach
They directly absorb all systemic toxins present in the stomach cavity
e: Advanced Explanation: Soluble antacids like sodium bicarbonate ($NaHCO_3$) can make the stomach contents alkaline if taken in excess. This triggers a homeostatic reflex that stimulates the secretion of even more acid. Incontrast, magnesium and aluminum hydroxides are insoluble; they buffer excess hydronium ions without raising the pH above neutral.

qe: The identification of specific histamine receptor antagonists transformed peptic ulcer therapy. Which historic drug was engineered to selectively block histamine receptors in the stomach?
qh: पेट के विशिष्ट हिस्टामाइन रिसेप्टर्स को चुनिंदा रूप से अवरुद्ध करने और गैस्ट्रिक अल्सर के इलाज के लिए किस ऐतिहासिक दवा को डिज़ाइन किया गया था?
o: Brompheniramine (Dimetapp)
Terfenadine (Seldane)
Prontosil rubrum
Cimetidine (Tegamet)
e: Advanced Explanation: Cimetidine (Tegamet) was designed to block histamine receptors in the stomach wall, effectively reducing acid secretion. It was a major breakthrough in ulcer therapy and was later followed by ranitidine.

qe: Antihistamine agents mitigate allergic symptoms like skin rashes and watery eyes. Which of the following is chemically classified as a popular systemic antihistamine drug?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे रासायनिक रूप से एक लोकप्रिय सिस्टेमिक एंटीहिस्टामाइन (antihistamine) दवा के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Cimetidine (Tegamet)
Ranitidine (Zantac)
Brompheniramine (Dimetapp)
Sodium propionate
e: Advanced Explanation: Brompheniramine (Dimetapp) and terfenadine (Seldane) are classic antihistamines that block the receptors responsible for nasal congestion and allergic inflammation, without interfering with the histamine pathways that regulate stomach acid.

qe: Neurologically active drugs alter the molecular communication pathways between nerves and receptors. These agents are divided into which two major therapeutic classes?
qh: तंत्रिका सक्रिय दवाओं (Neurologically active drugs) को किन दो प्रमुख उपचारात्मक श्रेणियों (therapeutic classes) में विभाजित किया गया है?
o: Antacids and Antihistamines
Tranquilizers and Analgesics
Antibiotics and Antiseptics
Anionic and Cationic detergents
e: Advanced Explanation: Neurologically active drugs influence nervous system signaling. They are split into two major therapeutic categories: Tranquilizers (used to treat anxiety and mental agitation) and Analgesics (used to relieve physical pain without depressing overall consciousness).

qe: Noradrenaline is a critical neurotransmitter involved in mood regulation. A significant drop in the concentration or signaling efficiency of noradrenaline can cause an individual to suffer from:
qh: मनुष्यों में मूड के नियमन में शामिल न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर नोराड्रेनालाईन (Noradrenaline) की सांद्रता या सिग्नलिंग दक्षता में भारी कमी आने से व्यक्ति किससे पीड़ित हो सकता है?
o: Hyperacidity
Bacterial inflammation
Clinical Depression
Acute insomnia induced by euphoria
e: Advanced Explanation: Noradrenaline is a key neurotransmitter that regulates mood. If its levels fall due to enzymatic breakdown, signal transmission slows down, leading to symptoms of clinical depression.

qe: Antidepressant medications function by modulating neurotransmitter pathways. What is the standard biochemical mechanism of these drugs?
qh: एंटी-डिप्रेसेंट (Anti-depressant) दवाओं की मानक जैव रासायनिक कार्यप्रणाली (biochemical mechanism) क्या है?
o: They accelerate the rate of cellular neurotransmitter absorption
They inhibit the enzymes responsible for degrading noradrenaline
They block post-synaptic receptors across brain tissue networks
They completely eliminate local hormone production paths entirely
e: Advanced Explanation: Antidepressant drugs like iproniazid and phenelzine function by inhibiting monoamine oxidase, the enzyme responsible for breaking down noradrenaline. Blocking this degradation increases neurotransmitter levels at the synapse, counteracting depression.

qe: Barbiturates are an important subclass of tranquilizers that function as powerful hypnotics. Structurally, these sedative compounds are derived from:
qh: बार्बिटुरेट्स (Barbiturates) ट्रैंक्विलाइज़र का एक महत्वपूर्ण उपवर्ग हैं जो शक्तिशाली सम्मोहक (hypnotics) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं। संरचनात्मक रूप से, ये शामक यौगिक किससे प्राप्त होते हैं?
o: Salicylamide rings
Barbituric acid
Sulfonamide group linkages
Arsphenamine coordination complexes
e: Advanced Explanation: Barbiturates (such as veronal, amytal, nembutal, luminal, and seconal) are synthetic derivatives of barbituric acid. They act as potent central nervous system depressants, making them highly effective sleep-inducing (hypnotic) agents.

qe: Analgesic drugs block pain pathways without inducing a state of generalized central nervous stupor. Which of the following is categorized as a 'Non-narcotic' analgesic?
qh: चेतना को प्रभावित किए बिना दर्द के संकेतों को रोकने वाली दवाओं में से निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'गैर-नार्कोटिक' (Non-narcotic) एनाल्जेसिक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Morphine
Codeine
Aspirin
Heroin
e: Advanced Explanation: Non-narcotic analgesics relieve pain without causing physical dependence or sedation. Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) and paracetamol are classic examples of non-narcotic pain relievers.

qe: Aspirin achieves its analgesic effect by blocking the synthesis of chemical compounds that cause localized tissue inflammation and pain. These targeted molecules are:
qh: एस्पिरिन उन रासायनिक यौगिकों के संश्लेषण को अवरुद्ध करके अपना एनाल्जेसिक प्रभाव प्राप्त करती है जो स्थानीय ऊतक सूजन और दर्द का कारण बनते हैं। इन लक्षित अणुओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Prostaglandins
Histamines
Neurotransmitters
Saponified glycerols
e: Advanced Explanation: Aspirin acts by irreversibly inhibiting cyclooxygenase enzymes, which halts the synthesis of prostaglandins. Prostaglandins are local chemical mediators that cause inflammation, sensitize nerve endings to pain, and regulate fever pathways in the brain.

qe: Apart from its primary role as an analgesic and antipyretic, Aspirin is widely prescribed to cardiovascular patients due to which specific secondary property?
qh: अपने प्राथमिक एनाल्जेसिक और एंटीपायरेटिक गुणों के अलावा, एस्पिरिन को हृदय रोगियों (cardiovascular patients) के लिए किस विशिष्ट माध्यमिक गुण के कारण निर्धारित किया जाता है?
o: Its anti-blood clotting activity via platelet aggregation inhibition
Its direct capacity to widen coronary blood vessels during stress
Its active suppression of cholesterol synthesis pathways within liver cells
Its capacity to directly cool cardiac tissues through metabolic means
e: Advanced Explanation: Aspirin exhibits anti-blood clotting activity by inhibiting thromboxane synthesis, which prevents platelet aggregation. This anticoagulant effect helps prevent blood clot formation inside blood vessels, reducing the risk of myocardial infarctions.

qe: Narcotic analgesics are powerful pain relievers but have a high potential for addiction. In which clinical scenario is the use of narcotic analgesics like Morphine legally preferred?
qh: मॉर्फिन (Morphine) जैसे नार्कोटिक एनाल्जेसिक शक्तिशाली दर्द निवारक हैं। किस नैदानिक परिदृश्य में इनके उपयोग को कानूनी और चिकित्सकीय रूप से प्राथमिकता दी जाती है?
o: Relief of severe pain in terminal cancer patients and post-operative trauma
Routine management of seasonal tension headaches
Alleviation of local swelling caused by systemic allergies
Reduction of core body temperature during prolonged viral fevers
e: Advanced Explanation: Narcotic analgesics like morphine, codeine, and heroin act on the central nervous system to relieve intense pain. Due to their addictive nature, their use is clinically restricted to severe cases, such as managing pain in terminal cancer, post-operative recovery, or severe cardiac events.

qe: The development of antimicrobials began with synthetic dyes targeting specific microbes. Which arsenic-based compound was synthesized by Paul Ehrlich as an effective cure for syphilis?
qh: रोगाणुरोधकों (antimicrobials) का विकास विशिष्ट रोगाणुओं को लक्षित करने वाले रंगों से शुरू हुआ। सिफलिस के इलाज के लिए पॉल एर्लिच द्वारा आर्सेनिक-आधारित किस यौगिक का संश्लेषण किया गया था?
o: Prontosil rubrum
Salvarsan (Arsphenamine)
Sulfanilamide
Penicillin G
e: Advanced Explanation: Paul Ehrlich synthesized Salvarsan (Arsphenamine), an organic arsenic-based compound, as an effective treatment for syphilis. This discovery laid the foundation for modern antimicrobial chemotherapy.

qe: In 1932, research into antimicrobial dyes led to the discovery of Prontosil, the first effective synthetic antibacterial agent. Inside the human body, Prontosil is metabolized into which active compound?
qh: 1932 में, रोगाणुरोधी रंगों के अनुसंधान से पहले प्रभावी सिंथेटिक जीवाणुरोधी एजेंट 'प्रोंटोसिल' (Prontosil) की खोज हुई। मानव शरीर के भीतर, प्रोंटोसिल किस सक्रिय यौगिक में परिवर्तित हो जाता है?
o: Sulfanilamide
Arsphenamine coordination species
Penicillamine fragments
Azolla complex linkers
e: Advanced Explanation: Prontosil is an azo dye precursor that is cleaved by metabolic pathways inside the host body. This reaction splits the molecule to release sulfanilamide, which acts as the true antibacterial agent.

qe: Antibiotics are classified as either bactericidal (killing bacteria directly) or bacteriostatic (inhibiting growth). Which of the following is an example of a 'Bacteriostatic' antibiotic?
qh: एंटीबायोटिक दवाओं को जीवाणुनाशक (bactericidal) या जीवाणुस्थैतिक (bacteriostatic) के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'जीवाणुस्थैतिक' एंटीबायोटिक का उदाहरण है?
o: Penicillin
Aminoglycosides
Ofloxacin
Erythromycin
e: Advanced Explanation: Antibiotics work through different mechanism: Bactericidal drugs like penicillin, aminoglycosides, and ofloxacin destroy bacterial cells directly. Bacteriostatic drugs like erythromycin, tetracycline, and chloramphenicol inhibit bacterial replication and protein synthesis without immediately killing the cells.

qe: Antibiotics are also categorized by their range of activity. What term describes an antibiotic that is highly effective against a wide variety of both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria?
qh: उस एंटीबायोटिक को क्या कहा जाता है जो ग्राम-पॉजिटिव और ग्राम-नेगेटिव दोनों प्रकार के बैक्टीरिया की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला के खिलाफ अत्यधिक प्रभावी है?
o: Broad-spectrum antibiotic
Narrow-spectrum agent
Limited-spectrum molecule
Monovalent target layout
e: Advanced Explanation: Broad-spectrum antibiotics, such as chloramphenicol, ampicillin, and amoxicillin, are effective against a wide range of both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. This makes them highly versatile for treating mixed or undiagnosed bacterial infections.

qe: Chloramphenicol is a highly potent broad-spectrum antibiotic discovered in 1947. For which of the following conditions is its oral administration specifically indicated?
qh: क्लोरैम्फेनिकॉल (Chloramphenicol) एक शक्तिशाली व्यापक-स्पेक्ट्रम एंटीबायोटिक है। निम्नलिखित में से किस नैदानिक स्थिति के लिए इसके मौखिक प्रशासन (oral administration) को विशेष रूप से निर्धारित किया जाता है?
o: Routine seasonal rhinovirus colds
Typhoid, acute diarrhea, and dysentery
Coronary arterial fatty deposits
Systemic type-2 diabetes complications
e: Advanced Explanation: Chloramphenicol is rapidly absorbed through the gastrointestinal tract, making it highly effective when administered orally for treating typhoid fever, acute diarrhea, dysentery, meningitis, and certain urinary tract infections.

qe: Antiseptics and disinfectants both destroy or inhibit micro-organisms, but they differ in their application parameters. What is the primary operational distinction between them?
qh: रोगाणुरोधक (Antiseptics) और कीटाणुनाशक (disinfectants) दोनों सूक्ष्म जीवों को नष्ट करते हैं या रोकते हैं। उनके उपयोग में प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Antiseptics are safe to apply to living tissues; disinfectants are toxic and restricted to inanimate objects
Disinfectants are safe for biological ingestion; antiseptics are environmental toxins
Antiseptics target viral pathogens exclusively; disinfectants disrupt bacterial walls
There is no functional distinction; both are deployed interchangeably in medical environments
e: Advanced Explanation: Antiseptics (such as furacinin and soframycin) are safe to apply directly to living tissues like cuts, wounds, and ulcers. Disinfectants (such as chlorine or sulfur dioxide solutions) are toxic to living tissues and are used exclusively on inanimate objects like floors, drainage systems, and surgical tools.

qe: Phenol is a unique chemical compound because its antimicrobial behavior changes based on its concentration. How does phenol function at different concentration levels?
qh: फिनोल (Phenol) एक अनूठा रासायनिक यौगिक है क्योंकि इसकी सांद्रता (concentration) के आधार पर इसका व्यवहार बदल जाता है। फिनोल विभिन्न सांद्रता स्तरों पर कैसे कार्य करता है?
o: A 1.0% solution is an antiseptic; a 0.2% solution is a disinfectant
A 0.2% solution is an antiseptic; a 1.0% solution is a disinfectant
A 0.2% solution is an antacid; a 1.0% solution is an antibiotic
It behaves identically as a safe skin antiseptic across all concentration levels
e: Advanced Explanation: Phenol displays concentration-dependent antimicrobial behavior: A dilute 0.2% aqueous solution of phenol acts as an antiseptic that is safe for living tissues. Increasing the concentration to a 1.0% solution makes it a powerful disinfectant used for environmental sanitation.

qe: Iodine is a powerful skin antiseptic. What is the composition of 'Tincture of Iodine', a common formulation used to treat minor cuts and wounds?
qh: मामूली कटने और घावों के इलाज के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले एक सामान्य फॉर्मूलेशन 'आयोडीन का टिंचर' (Tincture of Iodine) किसका मिश्रण होता है?
o: A 2–3% solution of iodine dissolved in an alcohol-water mixture
Pure elemental liquid iodine bound to thick glycerol oils
Insoluble calcium iodide salts suspended in absolute ethanol
A crystalline paste of iodoform combined with organic acids
e: Advanced Explanation: Tincture of iodine is a widely used antiseptic formulation composed of a 2–3% solution of elemental iodine dissolved in a liquid mixture of alcohol and water. It is applied topically to wounds to prevent infection.

qe: Boric acid exhibits mild antiseptic properties. In what form is its dilute aqueous solution specifically used in clinical medicine?
qh: नैदानिक चिकित्सा में बोरिक एसिड (Boric acid) के तनु जलीय घोल (dilute aqueous solution) का उपयोग विशेष रूप से किस रूप में किया जाता है?
o: As an oral antibiotic liquid syrup formulation
As a non-irritating, mild antiseptic eyewash
As a topical treatment paste for severe deep muscle burns
As a systemic neutralizing buffer for high stomach acidity
e: Advanced Explanation: Dilute aqueous solutions of boric acid ($H_3BO_3$) act as very mild, non-irritating antiseptics. It is clinically used as an effective eyewash to safely eliminate local micro-organisms without damaging sensitive ocular membranes.

qe: Antifertility drugs are essential components in oral contraceptives used for family planning. Chemically, what do these birth control pills typically consist of?
qh: गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों (birth control pills) में आमतौर पर क्या शामिल होता है?
o: A combination formulation of synthetic estrogen and progesterone derivatives
High baseline concentrations of natural plant-extracted lipids
Inhibitors designed to halt the systemic production of thyroid hormones
Saponified sodium metal salts of long-chain fatty acids
e: Advanced Explanation: Most oral birth control pills are formulations containing a combination of synthetic estrogen and progesterone derivatives. These synthetic hormones are more potent than natural ones and work by suppressing ovulation.

qe: The synthetic compound Norethindrone is a widely integrated active ingredient in oral contraceptive pills. Structurally, it is classified as a derivative of which hormone?
qh: मौखिक गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों में उपयोग किया जाने वाला सक्रिय घटक 'नोरेथिंड्रोन' (Norethindrone) संरचनात्मक रूप से किस हार्मोन का व्युत्पन्न (derivative) है?
o: Progesterone
Estrogen
Thyroxine
Cortisol
e: Advanced Explanation: Norethindrone is a potent synthetic derivative of the female hormone progesterone. Progesterone derivatives work by suppressing ovulation, making them highly effective in oral contraceptive formulations.

qe: Novestrol (ethynylestradiol) is an essential compound found in combination birth control pills. Which hormone derivative does this compound represent?
qh: संयोजन गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों में पाया जाने वाला यौगिक 'नोवेस्ट्रोल' (Novestrol) किस हार्मोन के व्युत्पन्न का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: An estrogen derivative
A progesterone variant
An androgen blocker
An insulin stabilizer
e: Advanced Explanation: Novestrol (ethynylestradiol) is a highly effective synthetic derivative of the hormone estrogen. In oral contraceptive pills, it is combined with a progesterone derivative to safely regulate and suppress ovulation.

qe: Chemical additives are routinely introduced into processed foods for various functional reasons. Which of the following is NOT a primary reason for adding these chemicals?
qh: प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य पदार्थों (processed foods) में रासायनिक योजक (chemical additives) मिलाने का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक प्राथमिक कारण नहीं है?
o: To preserve freshness and significantly extend shelf life
To enhance visual appeal with chemical coloring agents
To deliberately increase the nutritional caloric value of the food
To stabilize dynamic emulsification texturing properties
e: Advanced Explanation: Chemical food additives (such as colorants, stabilizers, buffers, and sweetening agents) are used to improve shelf life, appearance, and texture. Except for operational nutrient supplements like vitamins, these additives do not add structural calories to the food.

qe: Soaps are chemically defined as long-chain fatty acid salts. Structurally, they are synthesized as sodium or potassium salts of which organic acids?
qh: संरचनात्मक रूप से, साबुन किन कार्बनिक अम्लों के सोडियम या पोटेशियम लवण के रूप में संश्लेषित होते हैं?
o: Stearic, Oleic, and Palmitic acids
Acetic, Formic, and Benzoic acids
Oxalic, Citric, and Succinic acids
Sorbic, Propionic, and Nitric acids
e: Advanced Explanation: Soaps are the sodium or potassium salts of long-chain higher fatty acids, containing 15 to 18 carbon atoms. They are typically synthesized from natural fats using saturated or unsaturated organic acids like stearic, oleic, and palmitic acids.

qe: Saponification is the chemical reaction used to manufacture soap. What starting materials are required for this process?
qh: साबुनीकरण (Saponification) अभिक्रिया के लिए आवश्यक प्रारंभिक सामग्रियां (starting materials) क्या हैं?
o: Glyceryl esters of long-chain fatty acids heated with aqueous alkali solutions
Long-chain aliphatic alcohols combined with concentrated sulfuric acid
Polyethylene glycol mixed with volatile aromatic essential oils
Quaternary ammonium salts reacted with silver oxide compounds
e: Advanced Explanation: Saponification involves heating natural fats or oils—which are the glyceryl esters of long-chain fatty acids—with an aqueous solution of an alkali like sodium hydroxide ($NaOH$) or potassium hydroxide ($KOH$). This reaction breaks down the esters, yielding soap and glycerol.

qe: Glycerol is generated as a byproduct during saponification. How is this glycerol separated and recovered from the soap mixture on an industrial scale?
qh: साबुनीकरण के दौरान उपोत्पाद के रूप में मिलने वाले ग्लिसरॉल (Glycerol) को औद्योगिक पैमाने पर साबुन के मिश्रण से कैसे अलग किया जाता है?
o: By adding Sodium chloride to precipitate the soap, leaving glycerol in the lye
By using high-pressure centrifugal sorting machinery directly
By shifting the pH level to highly acidic parameters
By freezing the entire solution until the glycerol solidifies
e: Advanced Explanation: After saponification is complete, sodium chloride ($NaCl$) is added to the mixture. This lowers the solubility of the soap, causing it to precipitate out as a solid mass. The liquid left behind, known as spent lye, contains glycerol, which is then recovered using fractional distillation under reduced pressure.

qe: Potassium soaps are much softer and gentler on the skin than sodium soaps. How are these cosmetic soaps prepared during manufacturing?
qh: त्वचा पर अधिक कोमल होने वाले पोटेशियम साबुनों को निर्माण के दौरान कैसे तैयार किया जाता है?
o: By utilizing Potassium hydroxide instead of Sodium hydroxide in saponification
By washing raw sodium soaps with pure liquid potassium solutions
By adding high-molecular-weight potassium halides to the blend
By replacing natural fats with synthetic paraffin wax bases
e: Advanced Explanation: Potassium soaps are formulated using potassium hydroxide ($KOH$) instead of sodium hydroxide ($NaOH$) during the saponification reaction. This changes the structural characteristics of the salt, making the resulting soap significantly softer and gentler on the skin.

qe: Commercial laundry soaps often contain specific builders and fillers. Which compounds are typically added to laundry soaps as fillers?
qh: व्यावसायिक कपड़े धोने के साबुनों (commercial laundry soaps) में पूरक (fillers) के रूप में आमतौर पर कौन से यौगिक मिलाए जाते हैं?
o: Sodium silicate, sodium carbonate, and borax
Glycerol and high-molecular-weight oils
Polyethylene glycol ethers
Cetyltrimethylammonium halides
e: Advanced Explanation: Industrial laundry soaps contain builders and fillers like sodium silicate, sodium carbonate, borax, and sodium carboxymethylcellulose. These compounds prevent soil particles from redepositing onto fabrics and improve lathering performance.

qe: Synthetic detergents possess a significant advantage over natural soaps because they maintain cleaning efficiency even in hard water. Why can detergents clean effectively in hard water?
qh: सिंथेटिक अपमार्जक (Synthetic detergents) कठोर जल में भी प्रभावी ढंग से झाग और सफाई क्यों कर सकते हैं?
o: Their corresponding Calcium and Magnesium salts are completely water-soluble
They alter hard water divalent ions into neutral atomic states
They physically destroy the entire mineral content of the water
They form an insoluble layer that covers up hard water minerals
e: Advanced Explanation: Unlike natural soaps, synthetic detergents (such as alkylbenzene sulfonates) react with the calcium and magnesium ions in hard water to form calcium and magnesium sulfonate salts that are completely water-soluble. Because no insoluble precipitate forms, they lather and clean effectively.

qe: Structurally, what type of compound is the popular household anionic detergent 'Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate' classified as?
qh: लोकप्रिय घरेलू ऋणायनी अपमार्जक 'सोडियम डोडिसिलबेंजीन सल्फोनेट' को किस प्रकार के यौगिक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: The sodium salt of a sulfonated long-chain alkylbenzene
A quaternary ammonium salt with halide tracking
A condensation product ester of fatty molecules
A saponified tri-glyceride potassium linkage
e: Advanced Explanation: Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate is synthesized by alkylating benzene with a long-chain dodecyl group, sulfonating the ring with sulfuric acid, and neutralizing it with sodium hydroxide. This yields an anionic surfactant with excellent cleaning performance.

qe: Early synthetic detergents caused severe environmental pollution, creating massive foam deposits in rivers. This issue occurred because:
qh: शुरुआती सिंथेटिक अपमार्जक (synthetic detergents) नदियों और जल निकायों में गंभीर झाग की समस्या का कारण क्यों बने थे?
o: Their highly branched hydrocarbon chains resist biodegradation by bacteria
They react with dissolved oxygen to form stable toxic gases
They trigger rapid, uncontrolled growth of aquatic weeds
They accelerate the accumulation of heavy metal ions in the water
e: Advanced Explanation: Early synthetic detergents contained highly branched hydrocarbon chains. Soil and water bacteria cannot break down highly branched structures, leading to environmental persistence. The accumulation of these non-biodegradable detergents caused persistent foaming in rivers and wastewater treatment plants. Modern formulations use straight-chain alkyl groups, which are easily biodegradable.

qe: What specific concentration of phenol is used as an antiseptic, and what concentration acts as a disinfectant?
qh: फिनोल की किस विशिष्ट सांद्रता का उपयोग एंटीसेप्टिक के रूप में किया जाता है, और कौन सी सांद्रता कीटाणुनाशक (disinfectant) के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: 1.0 percent as antiseptic, 0.2 percent as disinfectant
0.5 percent as antiseptic, 2.0 percent as disinfectant
0.2 percent as antiseptic, 1.0 percent as disinfectant
2.0 percent as antiseptic, 0.5 percent as disinfectant
e: Explanation: Dilute solutions of some disinfectants can be used as antiseptics. For example, a 0.2 percent solution of phenol is an antiseptic, while its 1.0 percent solution acts as a disinfectant.

qe: Which of the following compounds is commonly added to toilet soaps to impart antiseptic properties?
qh: टॉयलेट साबुन में एंटीसेप्टिक गुण प्रदान करने के लिए आमतौर पर निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक मिलाया जाता है?
o: Sodium rosinate
Bithionol
Sodium dodecylbenzenesulphonate
Polyethylene glycol
e: Explanation: Bithionol (also called bithional) is a chemical compound specifically added to commercial soaps to impart antiseptic properties and reduce microbial growth on the skin.

qe: What is the primary difference between antiseptics and antibiotics regarding their mode of administration?
qh: उनके प्रशासन के तरीके (mode of administration) के संबंध में एंटीसेप्टिक्स और एंटीबायोटिक्स के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Antibiotics are applied to inanimate objects, whereas antiseptics are ingested.
Antiseptics can be ingested safely, whereas antibiotics are strictly for topical use.
Antiseptics cannot be ingested and are applied to living tissues, whereas antibiotics can be ingested.
Both antiseptics and antibiotics must be strictly injected intravenously.
e: Explanation: Antiseptics are applied externally to living tissues such as wounds, cuts, and diseased skin surfaces (e.g., soframicine). Unlike antibiotics, antiseptic medicines cannot be ingested.

qe: Birth control pills essentially contain a mixture of derivatives of which two sex hormones?
qh: जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों (birth control pills) में अनिवार्य रूप से किन दो सेक्स हार्मोन के व्युत्पन्नों का मिश्रण होता है?
o: Testosterone and Adrenaline
Estrogen and Progesterone
Oxytocin and Melatonin
Thyroxine and Insulin
e: Explanation: Chemical substances used to check pregnancy are called birth control pills. They essentially contain a mixture of synthetic estrogen and progesterone derivatives.

qe: What is the specific physiological function of progesterone derivatives present in birth control pills?
qh: जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों में मौजूद प्रोजेस्टेरोन व्युत्पन्नों का विशिष्ट शारीरिक कार्य क्या है?
o: They suppress ovulation.
They enhance the development of the uterine lining.
They stimulate the immediate release of eggs.
They increase the production of testosterone.
e: Explanation: In birth control pills, it is known that progesterone suppresses ovulation, preventing the release of an egg, while estrogen helps to control the menstrual cycle.

qe: Norethindrone is a common component of birth control pills. How is it chemically classified?
qh: नोरेथिंड्रोन जन्म नियंत्रण गोलियों का एक सामान्य घटक है। इसे रासायनिक रूप से कैसे वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: A synthetic estrogen derivative
An artificial sweetening agent
A synthetic progesterone derivative
A non-narcotic analgesic
e: Explanation: Norethindrone is a widely used synthetic progesterone derivative found in commonly used oral contraceptive pills.

qe: Novestrol, frequently used in combination with norethindrone in contraceptive pills, represents which class of compounds?
qh: गर्भनिरोधक गोलियों में नोरेथिंड्रोन के साथ संयोजन में अक्सर इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला नोवेस्ट्रोल, किस वर्ग के यौगिकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Estrogen derivative
Enzyme inhibitor
Progesterone derivative
Broad spectrum antibiotic
e: Explanation: Some commonly used birth control pills contain a mixture of norethindrone (a progesterone derivative) and novestrol (which is an estrogen).

qe: Aspirin is chemically known as 2-acetoxybenzoic acid. Which compound is acetylated to synthesize aspirin?
qh: एस्पिरिन को रासायनिक रूप से 2-एसिटोक्सीबेंजोइक एसिड के रूप में जाना जाता है। एस्पिरिन को संश्लेषित करने के लिए किस यौगिक का एसिटिलीकरण (acetylation) किया जाता है?
o: Benzoic acid
Salicylic acid
Phenol
Acetic anhydride
e: Explanation: Aspirin is prepared by the acetylation of salicylic acid using acetic anhydride in the presence of an acid catalyst ($H^+$), yielding 2-acetoxybenzoic acid (Aspirin) and acetic acid.

qe: What is the biochemical mechanism through which aspirin effectively relieves pain?
qh: वह जैव रासायनिक तंत्र क्या है जिसके माध्यम से एस्पिरिन प्रभावी ढंग से दर्द से राहत दिलाती है?
o: It accelerates the degradation of noradrenaline in the brain.
It inhibits the synthesis of prostaglandins that stimulate inflammation.
It acts as an antagonist at histamine receptor sites.
It competitively binds to the allosteric site of pain receptors.
e: Explanation: Aspirin inhibits the synthesis of compounds known as prostaglandins. Prostaglandins stimulate inflammation in the tissues and cause pain. By blocking them, aspirin effectively relieves pain.

qe: Apart from its antipyretic and analgesic properties, why is aspirin widely used to prevent heart attacks?
qh: अपने ज्वरनाशक (antipyretic) और एनाल्जेसिक गुणों के अलावा, एस्पिरिन का व्यापक रूप से दिल के दौरे को रोकने के लिए क्यों उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Because it decreases systemic blood pressure.
Because it dilates coronary arteries.
Because it has an anti-blood clotting action.
Because it dissolves cholesterol plaques.
e: Explanation: Aspirin has an anti-blood clotting action, which prevents blood platelet coagulation. Because of this property, it is widely prescribed to prevent heart attacks.

qe: Which classification of drugs is considered the most useful for medicinal chemists engaged in designing new medicines?
qh: नई दवाओं को डिजाइन करने में लगे औषधीय रसायनज्ञों (medicinal chemists) के लिए दवाओं का कौन सा वर्गीकरण सबसे उपयोगी माना जाता है?
o: Classification on the basis of chemical structure
Classification on the basis of pharmacological effect
Classification on the basis of molecular targets
Classification on the basis of drug action
e: Explanation: Drugs possessing some common structural features may have the same mechanism of action on a specific drug target (like proteins, nucleic acids). Classification based on molecular targets is the most useful for medicinal chemists designing new compounds.

qe: Which classification system of drugs provides doctors with the whole range of drugs available for treating a particular disease?
qh: दवाओं की कौन सी वर्गीकरण प्रणाली डॉक्टरों को किसी विशेष बीमारी के इलाज के लिए उपलब्ध दवाओं की पूरी श्रृंखला प्रदान करती है?
o: Classification based on molecular targets
Classification based on pharmacological effect
Classification based on chemical structure
Classification based on molecular weight
e: Explanation: Classification based on pharmacological effect is more useful for doctors because it groups drugs by their therapeutic use (e.g., all analgesics kill pain, all antiseptics kill microorganisms), providing a whole range of options for a specific disease.

qe: Sulphonamides are grouped together based on their chemical structure. What pharmacological activity is common to mostly all sulphonamides?
qh: सल्फोनामाइड्स (Sulphonamides) को उनकी रासायनिक संरचना के आधार पर एक साथ समूहीकृत किया जाता है। अधिकांश सल्फोनामाइड्स में कौन सी औषधीय गतिविधि आम है?
o: Antibacterial
Antidepressant
Antihistamine
Tranquilizing
e: Explanation: Drugs have been classified on the basis of chemical structures because those with common structural features often share similar activity. For example, all sulphonamides possessing a specific structural feature are mostly antibacterial.

qe: Noradrenaline is a vital neurotransmitter involved in mood regulation. A clinical drop in the levels of noradrenaline is primarily associated with which condition?
qh: नोराड्रेनालाईन मूड नियंत्रण में शामिल एक महत्वपूर्ण न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर है। नोराड्रेनालाईन के स्तर में नैदानिक गिरावट मुख्य रूप से किस स्थिति से जुड़ी है?
o: Gastric ulcers
Allergic hypersensitivity
Depression
Bacterial infection
e: Explanation: Noradrenaline plays an important role in mood changes. If its level in the body is low, the message transfer process becomes slow, and the person suffers from depression.

qe: How do antidepressant drugs biochemically counteract the effects of depression?
qh: एंटीडिप्रेसेंट दवाएं अवसाद (depression) के प्रभावों का जैव रासायनिक रूप से कैसे मुकाबला करती हैं?
o: By rapidly accelerating the synthesis of new noradrenaline.
By inhibiting the enzymes that catalyze the degradation of noradrenaline.
By competitively binding to the active site of dopamine receptors.
By acting as a direct substitute for the missing neurotransmitter.
e: Explanation: Antidepressant drugs inhibit the enzymes which catalyze the degradation of noradrenaline. When the enzyme is inhibited, noradrenaline is slowly metabolized and can activate its receptor for a longer period, counteracting depression.

qe: Salvarsan was the first effective synthetic medicine discovered for the treatment of a specific disease. Which disease does it treat?
qh: सल्वारसन (Salvarsan) किसी विशिष्ट बीमारी के इलाज के लिए खोजी गई पहली प्रभावी सिंथेटिक दवा थी। यह किस बीमारी का इलाज करती है?
o: Typhoid
Syphilis
Tuberculosis
Cholera
e: Explanation: Paul Ehrlich investigated arsenic-based structures to produce less toxic substances. Salvarsan was the first effective medicine discovered for the treatment of syphilis, an infectious disease.

qe: Which heavy metal acts as the central active component in the molecular structure of the drug Salvarsan?
qh: दवा सल्वारसन की आणविक संरचना में कौन सी भारी धातु केंद्रीय सक्रिय घटक के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: Lead
Mercury
Arsenic
Bismuth
e: Explanation: Salvarsan is an arsenic-containing drug. Paul Ehrlich investigated arsenic-based structures to develop this compound, which features an $As=As$ double bond, specifically for treating syphilis.

qe: The infectious disease Syphilis is caused by which of the following pathogenic bacteria?
qh: संक्रामक रोग सिफलिस (Syphilis) निम्नलिखित में से किस रोगजनक जीवाणु के कारण होता है?
o: Treponema pallidum
Mycobacterium tuberculosis
Salmonella typhi
Vibrio cholerae
e: Explanation: Syphilis is an acute and chronic infectious disease caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum. It is primarily a sexually transmitted infection.

qe: How is a 'Broad spectrum antibiotic' technically defined in pharmacology?
qh: फार्माकोलॉजी में 'ब्रॉड स्पेक्ट्रम एंटीबायोटिक' (Broad spectrum antibiotic) को तकनीकी रूप से कैसे परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: It targets only single, specific strains of resistant pathogens.
It exclusively eradicates Gram-negative bacterial strains.
It prevents viral replication inside human host cells.
It is effective against a wide range of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
e: Explanation: Broad spectrum antibiotics are effective against several different types of harmful bacteria, meaning they attack a wide range of both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria.

qe: Which of the following antibiotics is classically categorized as a narrow spectrum antibiotic?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस एंटीबायोटिक को क्लासिक रूप से नैरो स्पेक्ट्रम (narrow spectrum) एंटीबायोटिक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Tetracycline
Chloramphenicol
Penicillin-G
Ampicillin
e: Explanation: Antibiotics effective mainly against either gram-positive or gram-negative bacteria are narrow spectrum. While Chloramphenicol is a broad-spectrum antibiotic, Penicillin-G specifically has a narrow spectrum.

qe: Chloramphenicol is widely utilized in medicine due to its extensive range of action. It belongs to which class of antibiotics?
qh: क्लोरैम्फेनिकॉल का चिकित्सा में इसके व्यापक प्रभाव क्षेत्र के कारण व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है। यह एंटीबायोटिक दवाओं के किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
o: Narrow spectrum antibiotic
Broad spectrum antibiotic
Limited spectrum antibiotic
Antiviral antibiotic
e: Explanation: According to the pharmacological classification based on action spectrum, Chloramphenicol is defined as a broad spectrum antibiotic as it acts against a wide range of pathogens.

qe: Which operational definition best describes the medical function of an Analgesic drug?
qh: कौन सी परिचालन परिभाषा एनाल्जेसिक दवा के चिकित्सा कार्य का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करती है?
o: It abolishes pain while causing temporary impairment of consciousness.
It reduces or abolishes pain without causing impairment of consciousness or nervous disturbances.
It induces deep sleep to assist the body in combating mental fatigue.
It triggers localized numbness by destroying nerve endings.
e: Explanation: Analgesics reduce or abolish pain without causing impairment of consciousness, mental confusion, incoordination, paralysis, or some other disturbances of the nervous system.

qe: Which chemical substance released in the human body is primarily responsible for producing hypersensitivity reactions, such as allergies to dust or pollen?
qh: मानव शरीर में जारी कौन सा रासायनिक पदार्थ मुख्य रूप से अतिसंवेदनशीलता प्रतिक्रियाओं (hypersensitivity) का उत्पादन करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है, जैसे धूल या पराग से एलर्जी?
o: Histamine
Dopamine
Serotonin
Prostaglandin
e: Explanation: Histamine is a substance which, upon release in the body, produces hypersensitivity to dust, certain drugs, pollen, etc., leading to allergic reactions.

qe: Equanil is an important chemical compound used in medicine. To which class of neurologically active drugs does it belong?
qh: इक्वैनिल (Equanil) चिकित्सा में उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक महत्वपूर्ण रासायनिक यौगिक है। यह तंत्रिका संबंधी सक्रिय दवाओं के किस वर्ग से संबंधित है?
o: Antihistamine
Narcotic Analgesic
Tranquilizer
Antifertility drug
e: Explanation: Equanil is classified as a tranquilizer. Tranquilizers are chemical compounds used for the treatment of stress, mild, and severe mental diseases.

qe: During the preparation of shaving soaps, a gum called rosin is added. What specific chemical forms from this addition that helps the soap to lather well?
qh: शेविंग साबुन तैयार करते समय, रोसिन (rosin) नामक गोंद मिलाया जाता है। इस जोड़ से कौन सा विशिष्ट रसायन बनता है जो साबुन को अच्छी तरह झाग देने में मदद करता है?
o: Sodium laurylsulphate
Sodium carbonate
Sodium stearate
Sodium rosinate
e: Explanation: While preparing shaving soaps, a gum called rosin is added to them. It reacts to form sodium rosinate, which helps the soap to lather exceptionally well.

qe: Glycerol is an essential additive in shaving soaps. What is its primary functional purpose in the formulation?
qh: ग्लिसरॉल शेविंग साबुन में एक आवश्यक योज्य (additive) है। फॉर्मूलेशन में इसका प्राथमिक कार्यात्मक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To act as a water softener by removing calcium ions.
To increase the volume of the lather produced.
To prevent the soap from rapid drying on the skin.
To provide a pleasant artificial fragrance.
e: Explanation: Glycerol is specifically added to shaving soaps to prevent rapid drying, ensuring the lather remains moist and effective during the shaving process.

qe: Liquid dishwashing detergents typically belong to which structural category of synthetic detergents?
qh: तरल डिशवॉशिंग डिटर्जेंट आमतौर पर सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट की किस संरचनात्मक श्रेणी से संबंधित होते हैं?
o: Anionic detergents
Cationic detergents
Zwitterionic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
e: Explanation: Liquid dishwashing detergents are of the non-ionic type. Non-ionic detergents do not contain any ions in their chemical constitution and remove grease and oil by micelle formation.

qe: Non-ionic detergents are synthesized using specific long-chain organic molecules. Which two compounds react to form a standard non-ionic detergent?
qh: गैर-आयनिक (Non-ionic) डिटर्जेंट को विशिष्ट लंबी-श्रृंखला वाले कार्बनिक अणुओं का उपयोग करके संश्लेषित किया जाता है। एक मानक गैर-आयनिक डिटर्जेंट बनाने के लिए किन दो यौगिकों की प्रतिक्रिया होती है?
o: Stearic acid and Polyethylene glycol
Lauryl alcohol and Sulphuric acid
Cetyl bromide and Trimethylamine
Benzene and Dodecyl alcohol
e: Explanation: Polyethylene glycols are used in the preparation of non-ionic detergents. Specifically, stearic acid reacts with polyethylene glycol to form a liquid non-ionic detergent.

qe: Sodium lauryl sulphate is a very common household cleansing agent. Under which category of detergents is it classified?
qh: सोडियम लॉरिल सल्फेट एक बहुत ही आम घरेलू क्लींजिंग एजेंट है। इसे डिटर्जेंट की किस श्रेणी के तहत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Cationic detergents
Anionic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
Saponified natural soaps
e: Explanation: Sodium lauryl sulphate and sodium dodecylbenzenesulphonate are classic examples of anionic detergents, which are sodium salts of sulphonated long-chain alcohols or hydrocarbons.

qe: Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide is widely used in cosmetic products like hair conditioners. What type of detergent is it?
qh: सेटाइलट्रिमिथाइलअमोनियम ब्रोमाइड (Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide) का हेयर कंडीशनर जैसे कॉस्मेटिक उत्पादों में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है। यह किस प्रकार का डिटर्जेंट है?
o: Cationic detergent
Anionic detergent
Non-ionic detergent
Amphoteric detergent
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents are quaternary ammonium salts of amines with acetates, chlorides, or bromides as anions. Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide is a popular cationic detergent frequently used in hair conditioners.

qe: Which category of synthetic detergents is primarily used in the formulation of modern hair conditioners?
qh: आधुनिक हेयर कंडीशनर के निर्माण में मुख्य रूप से सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट की किस श्रेणी का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Non-ionic detergents
Anionic detergents
Cationic detergents
Alkali metal soaps
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents, such as cetyltrimethylammonium bromide, have germicidal properties and positively charged active parts, making them highly effective and popular for use in hair conditioners.

qe: Drugs dynamically interact with biological macromolecules in the human body to induce a response. Which of the following is NOT considered a macromolecular drug target?
qh: प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करने के लिए दवाएं मानव शरीर में जैविक मैक्रोमोलेक्यूल्स के साथ गतिशील रूप से परस्पर क्रिया करती हैं। निम्नलिखित में से किसे मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर ड्रग लक्ष्य (drug target) नहीं माना जाता है?
o: Proteins
Vitamins
Nucleic acids
Lipids
e: Explanation: Drugs usually interact with biomolecules such as carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids. These are collectively called drug targets. Vitamins are essential nutrients but are not classified as target molecules for drug function.

qe: In pharmacology, what is the specific role of a 'Non-competitive inhibitor' during enzyme interaction?
qh: फार्माकोलॉजी में, एंजाइम इंटरेक्शन के दौरान 'गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी अवरोधक' (Non-competitive inhibitor) की विशिष्ट भूमिका क्या है?
o: It directly competes with the natural substrate for the active catalytic site.
It permanently degrades the enzyme into inactive polypeptide fragments.
It binds to an allosteric site, altering the shape of the active site so the substrate cannot recognize it.
It binds strongly to the natural substrate, preventing it from approaching the enzyme.
e: Explanation: Non-competitive inhibitors do not bind to the active site. Instead, they bind to a different site called the allosteric site. This binding alters the three-dimensional shape of the active site, preventing the natural substrate from attaching.

qe: When an inhibitor attaches to an enzyme to block its catalytic activity, what type of chemical bond is generally formed between them?
qh: जब कोई अवरोधक अपनी उत्प्रेरक गतिविधि को रोकने के लिए किसी एंजाइम से जुड़ता है, तो उनके बीच आम तौर पर किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन बनता है?
o: A very strong permanent covalent bond
A strong metallic coordination bond
A weak bond such as hydrogen bonding or van der Waals interaction
A strictly ionic bond operating in a vacuum
e: Explanation: Generally, a weak bond such as hydrogen bonding, van der Waals’ interactions, etc., is formed between the enzyme and the inhibitor. Strong covalent bonds are rare as they would destroy the enzyme permanently.

qe: Aspartame is one of the most widely used artificial sweeteners, roughly 100 times sweeter than cane sugar. What is its major physical limitation?
qh: एस्पार्टेम सबसे व्यापक रूप से इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले कृत्रिम मिठास में से एक है, जो गन्ने की चीनी से लगभग 100 गुना अधिक मीठा है। इसकी प्रमुख भौतिक सीमा (physical limitation) क्या है?
o: It requires extremely low pH to dissolve in water.
It is unstable at cooking temperatures, limiting its use to cold foods.
It turns violently bitter when mixed with synthetic food dyes.
It provides massive amounts of unwanted caloric energy.
e: Explanation: The use of aspartame is strictly limited to cold foods and soft drinks because it decomposes and is chemically unstable at cooking temperatures.

qe: Chemically, what is the structural composition of the artificial sweetener Aspartame?
qh: रासायनिक दृष्टि से, कृत्रिम मधुरक एस्पार्टेम की संरचनात्मक संरचना क्या है?
o: A trichloro derivative of natural sucrose
The sodium salt of ortho-sulphobenzimide
A methyl ester of a dipeptide formed from aspartic acid and phenylalanine
A cyclic polymer of fructose and galactose molecules
e: Explanation: Aspartame is chemically a methyl ester of the dipeptide formed from two amino acids: aspartic acid and phenylalanine.

qe: Sucralose is a popular zero-calorie artificial sweetener that is highly stable at cooking temperatures. Structurally, what is Sucralose?
qh: सुक्रालोज़ एक लोकप्रिय शून्य-कैलोरी कृत्रिम मधुरक है जो खाना पकाने के तापमान पर अत्यधिक स्थिर है। संरचनात्मक रूप से, सुक्रालोज़ क्या है?
o: A trichloro derivative of sucrose
A sodium salt of a benzenesulphonate
A dipeptide linked with a methyl ester
A heavily hydrogenated starch polymer
e: Explanation: Sucralose is chemically a trichloro derivative of sucrose. Its appearance and taste perfectly mimic natural sugar, and it remains completely stable at elevated cooking temperatures.

qe: Receptor proteins are crucial to the body’s communication process. Where is the active binding site of these proteins positionally oriented?
qh: रिसेप्टर प्रोटीन शरीर की संचार प्रक्रिया के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं। इन प्रोटीनों का सक्रिय बाइंडिंग साइट (active binding site) स्थितीय रूप से कहाँ उन्मुख (oriented) होता है?
o: It is deeply buried within the cellular cytoplasm.
It is located exclusively inside the cell nucleus.
It projects out of the membrane and opens on the outside region of the cell.
It is completely detached and floats freely in the extracellular fluid.
e: Explanation: The majority of receptor proteins are embedded in cell membranes. Their small part possessing the active site projects out of the surface of the membrane and opens on the outside region of the cell to receive chemical messengers.

qe: How do chemical messengers successfully transfer critical information into a cell without physically entering it?
qh: रासायनिक संदेशवाहक (chemical messengers) भौतिक रूप से कोशिका में प्रवेश किए बिना उसमें महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी सफलतापूर्वक कैसे स्थानांतरित करते हैं?
o: They dissolve the lipid membrane temporarily to pass signals.
They emit localized electrical pulses that penetrate the nucleus.
They bind to the receptor, causing the receptor site to change shape and transfer the message.
They inject RNA strands through the cellular wall.
e: Explanation: Chemical messengers are received at the binding sites of receptor proteins. To accommodate a messenger, the shape of the receptor site changes. This structural shift brings about the transfer of the message into the cell, meaning the messenger gives the message without entering the cell.

qe: Food preservatives are vital for preventing microbial spoilage. Which of the following everyday chemicals is NOT used as a food preservative?
qh: माइक्रोबियल खराबी को रोकने के लिए खाद्य परिरक्षक (Food preservatives) महत्वपूर्ण हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा रोज़मर्रा का रसायन खाद्य परिरक्षक के रूप में उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है?
o: Table salt
Vegetable oils
Sodium benzoate
Sodium hydrogencarbonate
e: Explanation: The most commonly used food preservatives include table salt, sugar, vegetable oils, and sodium benzoate. Sodium hydrogencarbonate (baking soda) is an antacid and a leavening agent, not classified as a food preservative.

qe: Which chemical, formerly used as an anaesthesia in surgery, is now primarily utilized in the production of the freon refrigerant R-22?
qh: सर्जरी में एनेस्थीसिया के रूप में इस्तेमाल होने वाले किस रसायन का उपयोग अब मुख्य रूप से फ्रीन रेफ्रिजरेंट R-22 के उत्पादन में किया जाता है?
o: Boric acid
Iodoform
Chloroform
Chlorine
e: Explanation: CHCl3 (chloroform) was historically used as an anaesthesia in surgery but is now primarily used in the production of the freon refrigerant R-22.

qe: How does Iodoform ($CHI_3$) function as an antiseptic when applied to wounds?
qh: आयोडोफॉर्म ($CHI_3$) घावों पर लगाने पर एक एंटीसेप्टिक के रूप में कैसे कार्य करता है?
o: It produces iodine upon coming in contact with the skin.
It acts as a strong oxidizing agent that destroys bacterial DNA.
It coagulates the blood instantly to form a protective seal.
It releases chlorine gas which sterilizes the wound.
e: Explanation: Iodoform ($CHI_3$) produces iodine on coming in contact with skin, which is the actual agent responsible for its antiseptic properties for wounds.

qe: Which of the following acts as a weak antiseptic specifically formulated for the eyes in its dilute aqueous solution?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अपने तनु जलीय घोल में विशेष रूप से आंखों के लिए एक कमजोर एंटीसेप्टिक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Sodium hydrogencarbonate
Boric acid ($H_3BO_3$)
Dilute Sulphur dioxide
Iodoform
e: Explanation: Boric acid ($H_3BO_3$) in a dilute aqueous solution acts as a weak antiseptic specifically suitable for the eyes.

qe: At what concentration does Chlorine in an aqueous solution act effectively as a disinfectant?
qh: एक जलीय घोल में क्लोरीन कितनी सांद्रता पर कीटाणुनाशक (disinfectant) के रूप में प्रभावी ढंग से कार्य करता है?
o: 1.0 to 2.0 ppm
0.2 to 0.4 ppm
2.0 to 5.0 ppm
e: Explanation: Chlorine acts as a potent disinfectant when its concentration is maintained between 0.2 to 0.4 ppm in an aqueous solution.

qe: Sulphur dioxide ($SO_2$) exhibits disinfectant properties under which of the following conditions?
qh: सल्फर डाइऑक्साइड ($SO_2$) निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थिति में कीटाणुनाशक गुण प्रदर्शित करता है?
o: In highly concentrated acidic solutions
When mixed with heavy metals
In very low concentrations
When heated above 100°C
e: Explanation: Sulphur dioxide acts as a disinfectant only in very low concentrations.

qe: Barbiturates are an important class of drugs that are widely used as:
qh: बार्बिट्यूरेट्स दवाओं का एक महत्वपूर्ण वर्ग है जिसका व्यापक रूप से किस रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Broad spectrum antibiotics
Hypnotics or sleep-producing agents
Non-narcotic analgesics
Antihistamines for allergies
e: Explanation: Barbiturates constitute an important class of tranquilizers. They are commonly used as hypnotics, meaning they act as sleep-producing agents.

qe: Which of the following compounds is NOT a derivative of barbituric acid (i.e., not a barbiturate)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक बार्बिट्यूरिक एसिड का व्युत्पन्न (अर्थात बार्बिट्यूरेट) नहीं है?
o: Equanil
Luminal
Veronal
Seconal
e: Explanation: Veronal, luminal, seconal, amytal, and nembutal are all derivatives of barbituric acid. Equanil is a tranquilizer used for controlling depression and hypertension, but it is not a barbiturate.

qe: What is the specific mechanism by which sulpha drugs destroy bacteria and fungi?
qh: सल्फा दवाएं किस विशिष्ट तंत्र द्वारा बैक्टीरिया और कवक को नष्ट करती हैं?
o: By dissolving their lipid membranes
By interfering with their metabolism
By raising their internal temperature
By physically rupturing their cell walls
e: Explanation: Sulpha drugs are antimicrobial agents that kill bacteria and fungi by directly interfering with their metabolic processes.

qe: Why is the antibacterial drug Sulphapyridine no longer prescribed for the treatment of human infections?
qh: मानव संक्रमण के इलाज के लिए जीवाणुरोधी दवा सल्फापायरीडीन अब क्यों नहीं लिखी जाती है?
o: It triggers severe autoimmune responses.
It induces permanent sleep.
Its water solubility is pH dependent, risking bladder crystallization.
It immediately breaks down into toxic arsenic compounds.
e: Explanation: Sulphapyridine is no longer prescribed because its water solubility is very pH dependent, creating a high risk of crystallization within the bladder or urethra, which could lead to pain or blockage.

qe: The antibacterial drug Prontosil, used to treat general bacterial infections in humans, is also chemically known as:
qh: मनुष्यों में सामान्य जीवाणु संक्रमण के इलाज के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली जीवाणुरोधी दवा प्रोंटोसिल (Prontosil) को रासायनिक रूप से किस अन्य नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
o: Sulphapyridine
Sulphamidochrysoidine
Iproniazid
Phenelzine
e: Explanation: Prontosil is an early antibacterial drug that is also chemically referred to as sulphamidochrysoidine.

qe: Salvarsan is an effective antibacterial drug specifically designed to treat syphilis. It is based on which toxic element?
qh: साल्वरसन एक प्रभावी जीवाणुरोधी दवा है जिसे विशेष रूप से सिफलिस के इलाज के लिए बनाया गया है। यह किस विषैले तत्व पर आधारित है?
o: Arsenic
Mercury
Lead
Antimony
e: Explanation: Salvarsan is a synthetic organic arsenic-based antibacterial drug that was widely used in the treatment of syphilis.

qe: How do antidepressant drugs biochemically alter mood and behavior?
qh: एंटीडिप्रेसेंट दवाएं जैव रासायनिक रूप से मूड और व्यवहार को कैसे बदलती हैं?
o: By temporarily numbing the central nervous system.
By correcting chemical imbalances of neurotransmitters in the brain.
By reducing the flow of oxygenated blood to the brain.
By increasing the production of stomach acid.
e: Explanation: Antidepressants are substances which correct the chemical imbalances of neurotransmitters in the brain, thereby causing positive changes in mood and behavior.

qe: Iproniazid is an antidepressant drug that belongs to which specific chemical class?
qh: इप्रोनियाज़िड एक एंटीडिप्रेसेंट दवा है जो किस विशिष्ट रासायनिक वर्ग से संबंधित है?
o: Hydrazine drug
Barbiturate
Sulphonamide
Antibiotic
e: Explanation: Iproniazid is a hydrazine drug that is utilized primarily as an antidepressant.

qe: Phenelzine is a well-known drug used in the treatment of major depressive disorders. What is its common brand name?
qh: प्रमुख अवसादग्रस्तता विकारों (major depressive disorders) के उपचार में प्रयुक्त होने वाली प्रसिद्ध दवा फेनेलज़ीन (Phenelzine) का सामान्य ब्रांड नाम क्या है?
o: Nardil
Equanil
Luminal
Prontosil
e: Explanation: Phenelzine is an antidepressant medication that is widely known by its brand name, Nardil.

qe: The chemical compound Equanil is prescribed to patients primarily for controlling which two conditions?
qh: रासायनिक यौगिक इक्वैनिल (Equanil) मुख्य रूप से किन दो स्थितियों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए रोगियों को निर्धारित किया जाता है?
o: Bacterial infections and fevers
Hyperacidity and gastric ulcers
Depression and hypertension
Allergies and runny nose
e: Explanation: Equanil is a tranquilizer that is highly effective and widely used in controlling depression and hypertension.

qe: Ampicillin and Amoxycillin are widely used drugs in modern medicine. How are they related to Penicillin?
qh: आधुनिक चिकित्सा में एम्पीसिलीन और एमोक्सिसिलिन व्यापक रूप से उपयोग की जाने वाली दवाएं हैं। उनका पेनिसिलिन से क्या संबंध है?
o: They act as antagonists to Penicillin.
They are synthetic modifications of Penicillin.
They are the raw natural fungi from which Penicillin is extracted.
They neutralize the toxic effects of Penicillin.
e: Explanation: Ampicillin and Amoxycillin are synthetic modifications of the naturally occurring antibiotic Penicillin, developed to broaden its spectrum or improve absorption.

qe: Penicillin exhibits a bactericidal effect rather than a bacteriostatic one. How does it accomplish this?
qh: पेनिसिलिन जीवाणुस्थैतिक (bacteriostatic) के बजाय एक जीवाणुनाशक (bactericidal) प्रभाव प्रदर्शित करता है। यह ऐसा कैसे करता है?
o: By destroying the cell wall of the microorganism.
By starving the bacteria of oxygen.
By inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.
By neutralizing the acidic environment around the bacteria.
e: Explanation: Penicillin destroys bacteria outright by destroying the cell wall of the microorganism, which classifies its action as bactericidal (killing) rather than bacteriostatic (inhibiting growth).

qe: Penicillin, as an individual class of antibiotics, is generally categorized based on its action spectrum as a:
qh: एंटीबायोटिक दवाओं के एक व्यक्तिगत वर्ग के रूप में पेनिसिलिन को आम तौर पर इसकी क्रिया स्पेक्ट्रम के आधार पर किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: Universal spectrum antibiotic
Broad spectrum antibiotic
Narrow spectrum antibiotic
Placebo antibiotic
e: Explanation: Penicillins as a class are generally considered narrow spectrum antibiotics because they target specific types of bacteria. However, when used in combination with other antibiotics, they can act as broad spectrum.

qe: Why can excessive consumption of Sodium hydrogencarbonate ($NaHCO_3$) actually worsen stomach acidity issues?
qh: सोडियम हाइड्रोजन कार्बोनेट ($NaHCO_3$) का अत्यधिक सेवन वास्तव में पेट की अम्लता (acidity) की समस्या को क्यों बढ़ा सकता है?
o: It solidifies inside the stomach blocking digestion.
It rapidly absorbs all liquids, causing dehydration.
It forms toxic chlorine gas upon reacting with stomach acid.
It makes the stomach alkaline, which triggers the production of even more acid.
e: Explanation: While $NaHCO_3$ neutralizes excess acid, excessive intake can make the stomach excessively alkaline. The body's reflex response to an alkaline stomach is to trigger the production of even more hydrochloric acid.

qe: The popular antacid known as 'Milk of Magnesia' is an aqueous solution of which chemical compound?
qh: लोकप्रिय एंटासिड जिसे 'मिल्क ऑफ मैग्नेशिया' के नाम से जाना जाता है, किस रासायनिक यौगिक का जलीय घोल है?
o: Magnesium carbonate
Magnesium hydroxide
Magnesium sulphate
Aluminium hydroxide
e: Explanation: Milk of magnesia, which is used commonly as an antacid, is simply an aqueous suspension/solution of magnesium hydroxide.

qe: The fundamental cause of hyperacidity is the over-secretion of pepsin and hydrochloric acid in the stomach. Which specific chemical in the body stimulates this secretion?
qh: हाइपरएसिडिटी का मूल कारण पेट में पेप्सिन और हाइड्रोक्लोरिक एसिड का अत्यधिक स्राव है। शरीर में कौन सा विशिष्ट रसायन इस स्राव को उत्तेजित करता है?
o: Histamine
Insulin
Serotonin
Adrenaline
e: Explanation: Histamine is a naturally occurring chemical substance in the body that directly stimulates the secretion of pepsin and hydrochloric acid in the stomach walls.

qe: How did the drug Cimetidine revolutionize the treatment of hyperacidity and stomach ulcers?
qh: सिमेटिडाइन (Cimetidine) दवा ने हाइपरएसिडिटी और पेट के अल्सर के उपचार में कैसे क्रांति ला दी?
o: By absorbing acid directly like a sponge.
By preventing the interaction of histamine with receptors present in the stomach wall.
By neutralizing the acid to form salt and water instantly.
By permanently destroying the acid-producing glands.
e: Explanation: Cimetidine was uniquely designed to prevent the interaction of histamine with its specific receptors on the stomach wall. As a result, less HCl is released, treating the root cause of hyperacidity.

qe: Ranitidine is a widely used drug for curing hyperacidity. Based on its mechanism, it falls into which broader category of drugs?
qh: रैनिटिडाइन हाइपरएसिडिटी को ठीक करने के लिए व्यापक रूप से इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली दवा है। इसके तंत्र के आधार पर, यह दवाओं की किस व्यापक श्रेणी में आता है?
o: Antihistamine
Tranquilizer
Antibiotic
Analgesic
e: Explanation: Ranitidine, like Cimetidine, cures hyperacidity by blocking histamine receptors in the stomach. Therefore, it structurally falls into the category of antihistamines.

qe: Brompheniramine is an antihistamine drug. Unlike Ranitidine which treats stomach acidity, Brompheniramine is used to treat:
qh: ब्रोम्फेनिरामाइन एक एंटीहिस्टामाइन दवा है। रैनिटिडाइन के विपरीत, जो पेट की अम्लता का इलाज करता है, ब्रोम्फेनिरामाइन का उपयोग किसके इलाज के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Major depressive disorders
Bacterial infections
Runny nose, sneezing, itching and watery eyes caused by allergy
Severe physical pain and inflammation
e: Explanation: While some antihistamines target stomach receptors (like Ranitidine), Brompheniramine targets other histamine receptors and is used to treat allergy symptoms like runny nose, sneezing, itching, and watery eyes.

qe: Sodium salts of sulphonated long chain alcohols or hydrocarbons (like Sodium lauryl sulphate) belong to which class of cleansing agents?
qh: सल्फोनेटेड लंबी श्रृंखला वाले अल्कोहल या हाइड्रोकार्बन (जैसे सोडियम लॉरिल सल्फेट) के सोडियम लवण क्लींजिंग एजेंटों के किस वर्ग से संबंधित हैं?
o: Natural soaps
Cationic detergents
Anionic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
e: Explanation: Anionic detergents are explicitly defined as sodium salts of sulphonated long chain alcohols or hydrocarbons. Sodium lauryl sulphate is a classic example.

qe: Which type of detergents are chemically described as quarternary ammonium salts of amines with acetates, chlorides, or bromides as anions?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से किस प्रकार के डिटर्जेंट को एमाइन के चतुर्धातुक अमोनियम लवण (quarternary ammonium salts) के रूप में वर्णित किया जाता है जिसमें आयनों के रूप में एसीटेट, क्लोराइड या ब्रोमाइड होते हैं?
o: Anionic detergents
Cationic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
Saponified soaps
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents are structurally quarternary ammonium salts of amines with anions such as acetates, chlorides, or bromides (e.g., Cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide).

qe: Cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide is a popular synthetic cleansing agent. To which category of detergents does it belong?
qh: सेटिलट्रिमिथाइल अमोनियम ब्रोमाइड एक लोकप्रिय सिंथेटिक क्लींजिंग एजेंट है। यह डिटर्जेंट की किस श्रेणी से संबंधित है?
o: Cationic detergents
Anionic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
Zwitterionic detergents
e: Explanation: Cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide is a quarternary ammonium salt with a bromide anion, classifying it as a typical cationic detergent.

qe: Non-ionic detergents do not contain any ions. They are typically formed by the chemical reaction between:
qh: गैर-आयनिक (Non-ionic) डिटर्जेंट में कोई आयन नहीं होता है। वे आमतौर पर किन रसायनों के बीच रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया से बनते हैं?
o: Lauryl alcohol and concentrated sulfuric acid
Stearic acid and polyethylene glycol
Amines and acetate ions
Benzene and dodecanol
e: Explanation: Non-ionic detergents are formed via an esterification-like reaction between a fatty acid, such as stearic acid, and a polymer like polyethylene glycol.

qe: Among the different classes of synthetic detergents, which specific class is known to inherently possess germicidal properties?
qh: सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट के विभिन्न वर्गों में से, किस विशिष्ट वर्ग को स्वाभाविक रूप से रोगाणुनाशक (germicidal) गुण रखने के लिए जाना जाता है?
o: Cationic detergents
Anionic detergents
Non-ionic detergents
Neutral detergents
e: Explanation: Cationic detergents (quarternary ammonium salts) uniquely possess strong germicidal properties alongside their cleansing action.

qe: Why is the branching of hydrocarbon chains intentionally kept to a minimum in the manufacturing of modern synthetic detergents?
qh: आधुनिक सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट के निर्माण में हाइड्रोकार्बन श्रृंखलाओं की शाखाओं (branching) को जानबूझकर न्यूनतम क्यों रखा जाता है?
o: To prevent the detergents from exploding under heat.
To make them easier to dissolve in concentrated acids.
So that the detergents become easily biodegradable by bacteria.
To increase their foam-producing capacity in hard water.
e: Explanation: Bacteria cannot easily degrade detergents containing highly branched hydrocarbon chains. Minimizing branching ensures the detergents become easily biodegradable, preventing severe environmental water pollution.

qe: What is a major functional advantage of synthetic detergents over traditional natural soaps?
qh: पारंपरिक प्राकृतिक साबुनों की तुलना में सिंथेटिक डिटर्जेंट का एक प्रमुख कार्यात्मक लाभ क्या है?
o: They are completely edible and safe for human consumption.
They can produce foam even in ice-cold water.
They act as a permanent cure for skin diseases.
They contain 100% natural organic oils.
e: Explanation: Synthetic detergents are highly efficient cleansing agents that do not react with hard water minerals and can give foam even in ice-cold water, unlike traditional soaps.

qe: In the context of medicinal chemistry, the term 'drug' specifically refers to chemicals that have an average molecular mass of:
qh: औषधीय रसायन विज्ञान के संदर्भ में, 'ड्रग' (drug) शब्द विशेष रूप से उन रसायनों को संदर्भित करता है जिनका औसत आणविक द्रव्यमान (molecular mass) होता है:
e: Explanation: Drugs are defined as chemicals of relatively low molecular masses, typically falling in the range of ~100 to 500 unified atomic mass units (u).

qe: The branch of science that involves the systematic use of chemical substances for achieving a therapeutic effect is known as:
qh: विज्ञान की वह शाखा जिसमें चिकित्सीय प्रभाव प्राप्त करने के लिए रासायनिक पदार्थों का व्यवस्थित उपयोग शामिल है, क्या कहलाती है?
o: Radiotherapy
Physiotherapy
Chemotherapy
Biotherapy
e: Explanation: The specific use of chemicals for the diagnosis, prevention, and therapeutic treatment of diseases is formally termed Chemotherapy.

qe: Soframicine is a chemical applied to living tissues like wounds and cuts to prevent microbial growth. Therefore, it is strictly classified as an:
qh: सोफ्रामाइसिन (Soframicine) एक रसायन है जिसे घावों और कटने जैसे जीवित ऊतकों पर सूक्ष्मजीवों के विकास को रोकने के लिए लगाया जाता है। इसलिए, इसे कड़ाई से किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Antacid
Antiseptic
Antibiotic
Analgesic
e: Explanation: Antiseptics are chemicals which kill or prevent the growth of microorganisms and are fundamentally safe to be applied to living tissues. Soframicine is a prime example of an antiseptic.

qe: Receptors are crucial proteins for cellular communication. Where are these receptors structurally located to receive chemical messengers?
